column1: 650|I admit I was once nice to you, but that was politeness, not feeling.
651|I often put off replying to you until bedtime, then sleep right after.
652|You said you wanted a home with me. I said the word home is too heavy.
653|If you still miss me, you simply have not woken up yet.
654|You wanted me to be more serious. I said if I were serious you would be afraid.
655|You cried until three in the morning. I saw the message at noon the next day.
656|You say I changed. I did not change, I have always been like this. You are just beginning to see it.
657|We are not compatible?
658|No. You are not good enough. Do not blame compatibility.
659|If you truly let it go, do not open this page again.
660|Every bit of tenderness I gave you came with a price.
661|You said you did not want to lose me. I said then do not lose me.
662|If you still cannot figure it out, that is your problem.
663|You treat me as light. I just happened to shine on you once.
664|I read half of your long message and replied: hmm.
665|The answer you wanted I gave you long ago. You simply refused to hear it.
666|You said you wanted to grow old with me slowly. I said that is too slow.
667|Enough. Stop refreshing the conversation.
668|You said you were leaving. I said safe travels. In fact, I was waiting for you to actually go.
669|Stop waiting for someone who will not write back.
670|Sometimes I thought about being nicer to you, then I realized there was no need.
671|You wanted to hear me say I like you. I said those three words are too heavy.
672|If you truly understood, you would know to delete me.
673|The meal you cooked for me, I ate two bites and said I was full.
674|You made me your support. I found even leaning on you heavy.
675|You said you wanted to see the sea with me. I said what is so good about the sea.
676|The harder you hold, the looser I let go.
677|Stop waiting. There will be no surprise.
678|You take every word I say seriously, which makes me more and more careless in what I say.
679|You take every time I approach you as a signal. I am just bored.
680|I am not worth it. Stop moving yourself.
681|I admit I am selfish, but I never promised you generosity.
682|That is the answer you wanted. Read it and delete it.
683|You asked why I did not reply. I said I did not see it. In fact, I did not want to.
684|What you read as flirtation was me being too lazy to shut it down.
685|Let us end it like this, and neither owes the other anything.
686|You said you waited for me until dawn. I said sleep early, it is better for your health.
687|I never planned to have a future with you, so none of the future you planned stayed in my memory.
688|You said you cried for me many times. I said then drink more water.
689|You were something to pass the time when I was bored, forgotten the moment I got busy.
690|You take my indifference as depth. I simply do not care.
691|I kept you not because you are good, but because you are useful.
692|Let me be clear first: I am not saying this to win you back, I am saying it because you are too noisy.
693|Stop being nice to me from now on. It is a waste.
694|Stop asking. Once you hear it you will not sleep anyway.
695|If you are truly smart, pretend you never met me today.
696|You want the truth?
697|The truth is: I stopped wanting to answer your calls long ago.
698|This ends here. Do not keep asking.
699|The humbler you are, the more pointless it feels.
700|You are so good at enduring. Endure once more, and this time it is your unwillingness.
701|That is it. Stop acting.
702|I am not short of people chasing me. What I lack is someone I would bother to care for. Unfortunately, that is not you.
703|Hate me if you want. I do not care.
704|Do not think so highly of me. I do not live up to the fantasy you built.
705|You deserve someone better, and that someone is not me. It is easy for me to say.
706|After saying all this, I actually feel lighter.
707|Do not cry. No one will feel sorry for your tears.
708|Stop turning yourself into this for anyone again.
709|I never stayed up one night for you. The nights you stayed up were your own choice.
710|To put it harshly, you do not even qualify to trouble me.
711|Honestly, you deserve to be loved well. Just not by me.
712|You put me first. I put you under: talk about it when I am free.
713|I will not see you off. Walk faster on your own.
714|I never lied to you. I just never corrected you.
715|I wanted to say these words long ago. I simply could not be bothered to open my mouth.
716|These words are ugly, but I did not lie once.
717|It is supposed to feel bad. That is how you remember it.
718|You be sad, and I will sleep when I should.
719|Do not misunderstand. From the start I never meant to be serious.
720|I am not good at cherishing things, and I do not plan to learn.
721|Stop making excuses for me. I simply do not care.
722|I set your calls to silent, your messages to do not disturb.
723|Stop imagining that you mean something. Really.
724|Your weight in my life is so light that even I am surprised.
725|You said you only wanted me to listen seriously once. I said go ahead, then started scrolling.
726|I admit, I enjoy being the center of your attention.
727|Here you are a backup among backups.
728|This is the end. Do not walk any further.
729|You held out your heart to me. I found it took up space.
730|I never meant to explain anything to you, because you are not worth the words.
731|Pretend I never appeared.
732|You always say I am hot and cold. In fact, I have always been leaving.
733|You can hate me, but stop asking why.
734|You left, taking all my love with you, on the strength of one sentence: let us break up.
735|I held back tears watching your back, wanting to hold you one last time, wanting to say I love you one last time.
736|I really want to ask you: was there ever a moment when you felt for my persistence, understood my humbleness, saw my helplessness? Was there ever a moment you felt you loved me?

737|On the way home I cried, the tears collapsing again. I walked on with no strength left, no longer daring to be proud or to ask for anything. What else could I say, what else could I do? I wished so much that you would hear me. Because I loved you, I let you go.
738|My whole life has been a failure. Three years and no rain, a lifetime and not one I love you.
739|I am not disappointed in you. I am disappointed in love.
740|It is nothing like what I imagined.
741|All it gives is waiting, and endless anxiety over gains and losses.
742|Goodbye. I loved you so much. Clumsy as I was, I tried hard and did a lot, so I have no regrets.
743|Now I give love back to you. Will you give me back the little pride I have left?
744|I am not waiting for you to like me. I am waiting for myself to stop liking you.
745|I am not waiting anymore. Let us pretend the wind never blew.
746|You never came, and I never loved.
747|When all word of you is gone, I will love the rest of the world again.
748|It seemed like you liked me too. But if you are going to miss me, then miss me.
749|Actually I want to say: since you left, I have not been well. Truly, not well at all.
750|I really loved you. I closed my eyes thinking I could forget, but the tears that fell did not fool me.
752|There is only so much warmth in me, and I gave it all to you. But you left me. How am I supposed to smile at anyone again?
753|Every relationship that drifts away from you, a friendship that fades or a lover who leaves, as long as you do not cling and do not drain yourself, will one day be made up to you in another form.
754|Without love, the earth becomes a grave.
755|My love is with you.
756|Even before I leave, I am already missing you.
757|Everyone has a star that watches over them. They say it is the heart of the one they love.
758|My dear, I have carved your name on a star. That is the star I watch over and love you with.
759|I will miss you at every step of the long road.
760|Wherever you are, however busy you are, I will be waiting here.
761|Passionate love is an urge that cannot be held back.
762|It is good that you left. Now I no longer have to worry about when you will leave.
763|I am sorry. Please keep believing in love. It was my fault that your first love came to nothing. Be your own West Continent, and wait for the dream that belongs to you.
764|Loud departures are only tests. Real departures are always silent. Which means, you made me wait so long because you never planned to come back.
765|You are so obviously perfunctory. How am I supposed to play along?
766|I am still as I was, living a life neither salty nor bland.
767|Three meals a day, on schedule. Loving you too.
768|White tea, quiet joy, nothing else to do. I am waiting for the wind, and for you. Bitter wine, broken willow, now we part. No wind, no moon, no you.
770|If I cannot be your only one, I will not even be your favorite.
771|Perhaps what I love is no longer you, but the passion I poured into you.
772|I am still standing here, foolishly waiting for you to come back.
773|You ask how much I love you. Roughly this: meet you a hundred more times, and I would fall a hundred more times.
774|Do you feel for me? My heart is with you now, so whether it hurts is up to you.
775|The love I want is very simple.
776|When I speak, you listen.
777|When I need you, you are there.
778|When I turn around, you are still there. That is enough.
779|Let the empty days be filled by you. Calm or brilliant, I like it. Let the journey of life be walked with you. Rough or smooth, I am willing.
780|I watch your life like a passer-by, aching at your joys and sorrows.
781|Next time, could it be your turn to put down your pride and like me to the point of madness.
782|If you liked me even a little, I could keep going.
783|After we parted, I turned myself into you.
784|You think my silence is a contest with you. It is disappointment and slow distance. Every second of being unvalued, I step back.
785|Maybe only much later will you understand how much courage someone as stubborn as me needed to beg you not to leave me, and how much force it took to push you out of my life completely.
786|I once thought that without you I had lost the whole world. But now you are gone, and my world is still here.
787|So losing a lover has nothing to do with the world. So I was only briefly unable to see the way, or unwilling to walk on. So you hurt me only because I gave you the chance.
788|The days pass slowly, life is a mess. Apart from missing you, I cannot do anything well.
789|When you do well I feel for myself. When you do badly I feel for you. I hope you do well, but do not let me know.
790|My love, my love, if the typhoon had not come, I could have kissed you.
791|You are lost in the crowd, and I follow behind you, hand out afraid of a mistake, hand back afraid of missing you.
792|We are all too timid. In the Republic we dared not become warlords.
793|In chaos we dared not rise up, and in peacetime we dare not say I love you.
794|What a pity. I said the words I did not mean, and you went along with them.
795|I am glad I met you, and sorry that all I did was meet you.
796|If I had the right to say your name, I would need no caption at all.
797|It is good to have someone with you through the low points. If not, I will wait for you in the wind on the mountain top.
798|I still like you very much. But this is as far as it goes.
799|I am still imagining that one late night you will send me a long message, shorter is fine too, telling me that all these days, you missed me too.
800|It is not that I do not reach out. It is that you make me feel like I am intruding.
801|If one day we meet, what should I say?
802|Long time no see, or I still love you.
803|What a pity. I said the words I did not mean, and you actually went along with them.
804|You were the one who came to me, and you were the one who broke up. Stop playing with me like this.
805|Run away with me, while the night is deep and love grows thick, in the sunset and the dusk.
806|I always love talking with you about the universe, tenderness, the wind that smells of orange soda, and the blue sunset.
807|You are not reluctant, so I have no right to be sad.
808|While I was happily planning our future, you were planning how to leave.
809|But when dawn came I still did not know whether you ever loved the moon.
810|That day the car window fogged up and I wrote your name. Then the fog cleared, and you were gone. We cannot go back.
811|What a pity that I was never firmly chosen by you.
812|Being suitable really does matter more than liking. Later you chose suitable, and I lost to liking.
813|Whether the ending is perfect or not, I loved you, for a whole once upon a time.
814|I am fine. I think I should sleep. Staying up is bad, and missing you is bad too.
815|Everyone who came after you, I am still afraid to hope too much. It is a shadow, and also a lesson.
816|May you be the hedgehog. I give you a soft embrace, and you give me love that leaves me bleeding.
817|Without realizing it, I found out that I love you this much.
818|When you ignore me, I feel the whole world ignores me. When you care about me, I cannot help ignoring the whole world.
819|Our love that never came to anything left memories that never came to anything.
820|My love for you is not mature, but it is sincere.
821|My love is never temporary. Where you are, it is.
822|I do not think I understand what liking is, but I just want to walk toward you.
823|You are always here, I always love, and love most, and only.
824|What hiding from the world and loving in secret. I am not afraid of the world. I will always love you.
825|In an age where love rises and falls with the wind, I want to take it slowly with you.
826|My love for you is open and unashamed, deep and unhurried.
827|Take one step toward me, and my love for you can no longer be hidden.
828|Like the sun going down, the lamps on the poles and the moon glowing faintly, my liking for you is a gentle fall.
829|I do not really understand what liking is, but I just want to walk toward you.

830|I think it hurts more to let the other person quietly give for you. If someone does not love you, it is like that, and time makes you forget. But when the one you love quietly endures suffering that is not hers, you never forget it in a lifetime.
831|A life holds so many regrets.
832|Gone in a blink.
833|How I want to go back to before.
834|May you be safe and well where I cannot see you.
835|Because of you, I learned what love is.
836|Love is the best pick-me-up in life.
837|Love never dies.
838|With you, darkness is no longer darkness.
839|It is good to know you. A step further is a mistake, a step back is a regret.
840|Right between that step, I truly wish time were eternal, space eternal, everything eternal.
841|In this world, a man's most precious possession is a woman's heart.
842|There is one word that frees us from all the burdens and pains of life: love.
843|Days without you are like a book with no pages.
844|Love is showing your truest self so the other can see clearly: this is who I am, love me or not, your choice.
845|Because love means you made the mistake, and I am willing to bear it with you.
846|When I think of you, my heart always stirs with something sour and sweet, a feeling that pulls me in too deep to escape.
847|I like the feeling of being held by you, that tight, breathless feeling. It is the warmth I crave, the closeness I love.
848|Of course I love you. That you never felt it is my failing.
849|Others cannot define me. You did not take the wrong road. You are waiting for the wind, gathering strength in the harbor until the good wind rises.
850|When I am lonely and helpless, your figure only ever appears at the horizon.
851|It is hard to say something as ethereal as I will always love you. But you must know this: right now I love you most, and I am willing to drown in this moment forever.

852|I am the one who secretly wrote your name on scratch paper. I am the one who wrote it in the snow. I am the one who breathed on the mirror and wrote it there. I am the one who took detours to run into you. I am the one who wanted to lose weight for you. What you never knew was you.

853|On the road of reincarnation, no matter how much we forget the past life, the blurred mind still remembers a figure. I can no longer be sure it is you. But I am sure that in the love I lost, my longing for you is hidden.
854|A cat's tenth life is death, a fish's eighth second is forgetting. How many disappointments does it take before I stop loving you.
855|Whenever your name or the past comes up, I fall silent and cannot speak.
856|You suddenly reminded me that we have known each other for years now. You found the one you love, and I am still lingering in the same place.
857|Whenever the message tone sounds, I always think it is you. In the end it is always bitter.
858|You and snow have one thing in common. The tighter I hold, the faster you disappear.
859|So blurred. I cannot see myself clearly, and I cannot see you clearly.
860|My eyes have embraced your back countless times.
861|I remember at the very beginning, you told me even when you saw a puppy.
862|You drink your tea, I taste my strong liquor. From now on our paths divide, and we never meet again in this life.
863|I cannot stop the wind that wants to leave, and I cannot hold you who wants to go. Being single is only loneliness, but settling is torture.
864|It seems your life would not go wrong without me. You are happy when you are happy, sad when you are sad. In your world I stand alongside all things, or perhaps below all things.
865|I slowly got used to life without you, but in some careless moment, missing you still floods back.
866|You are the dream I keep losing and worrying over. I am someone dispensable to you.
867|After all, the arrow that crosses mountains and rivers only pierces those who love too deeply.
868|The last gift I give you is a hot tear falling deep in your youth.
869|Why did you come, whether I minded or not. Why did you leave again, whether I was willing or not.
870|Once I wanted to share all my secrets with you. Now you have become the secret in my heart.
871|I can drink strong liquor, and I can get through the late autumn without you. I hope you never have a weakness, unlike me, who loses the moment someone mentions you.
872|You come, and I treat it as if you will never leave. You go, and I treat it as if you never came.
873|No need to hurry to feel better. I will sit with you for a while.
874|If you are sad, cry. When you are done, I will walk with you.
875|Your heart is raining. Let me hold the umbrella for a while.
876|Turning around, a wisp of cold fragrance fades far. The snow is deep, the smile is shallow.
877|In the next life, will you ferry me across, if you are willing?
878|That day I dreamed of your wedding. The flames blazed, and the one in the sedan was not me.
879|I am the calamity you cannot cross, no matter how many mountains and rivers you go through.
880|In this life you cannot become my poem, and I cannot enter your dream.
881|I had the luck to meet you, but not the ability to keep you.
882|You are ice that never melts in ten thousand years, I am fire that never dies.
883|You are the one I could meet but not seek, could meet but not keep, could meet but not have.
884|I hope you do well, but do not let me know.
885|May your years be without waves, and my remaining life without joys or sorrows.
886|This world can hold me, and it can hold you, but it cannot hold us.
887|If I had never met you, perhaps I would not be who I am now.
888|You do not need to worry about losing me. I am the one tiptoeing in fear.
889|If 2025 comes and you recall the past with tears, remember: I never wrote farewell with tears.
890|Stop attacking yourself. You are your own comrade in arms.
891|There are a thousand kinds of beauty in this world, and you alone hold my heart.
892|One casual sentence from you kept me awake all night, while you slept peacefully.
893|If I could go back, I would rather never have known you. Not because I regret it, but because I cannot face an ending without you.
894|Could you stir this coffee for me? Why do you want me to stir it? Because then I do not need to add sugar.
895|Where I can see you, my eyes are with you. Where I cannot see you, my heart is with you.
896|Do not go too far. Be careful not to tire my heart out.
897|I stubbornly thought I could smile calmly at anything. But the moment you turned and decided to leave, my tears poured out and could not be stopped.
898|Are you in a good mood?
899|Lend it to me for a few days. Mine is broken.
900|What you see is what I am. Good or bad, I do not argue.
901|The light is green. You go straight. I turn right.
902|You said you would protect me, but every storm came from you.
903|Later, no matter how many people I met, all I could do was sigh: not you.
904|There is no more you in this world. You died in my heart, at the south wall I smashed into.
905|No one in my world is like you. Anyone in your world could be me.
906|At four in the morning I saw the crabapple flowers still awake, and I kept feeling you should be beside me.
907|What I cannot let go of is not you, but the version of me who would give up everything for you.
908|If I could, I truly would rather never have met you. If I could, I would make us strangers who never met. If I could, in the next life we would never meet again.
909|I used to think the best thing in life was meeting.
910|Later I understood that what is truly rare is meeting again. If we could reunite after a long parting, I hope you are well.
911|My feelings for you end here. There is nothing good to wish you, and forced words would not sound pretty either. Just walk your road well, and please, please, do not provoke me again.
912|You only acted out a deep, ocean-wide romance with me.
913|I fell into the story, while you only practiced your acting once.
914|I know nothing of that part of your life, and you were thousands of miles away and never stood in that rain with me.

915|May every wild place have fog lights, and may you come across the river holding a torch, lighting up my lonely youth. After that the night train no longer heads to a lonely shore, and every drifting in wind and rain has a boat to return to.
916|Are you there? This one is visible only to you. I have a new moon now.
917|Sorry. You did not rise for too long, so I stopped waiting.
918|You are the one I cannot let go of even after gathering enough disappointment.
919|If I meet you in the next life, I will be sure to avoid you.
920|I am starting to feel lucky that you appeared at an age when I could afford to lose.
921|Where are you going? We are not on the same road anymore.
922|Do you have time to go look at the stars and dry the moon with me?
923|If the moon and stars are busy, we can stand under a street lamp, if you have time.
924|Today I went downstairs and found the 24-hour convenience store closed. And you, when did you start lying to me?
925|Let this life count as having married you. In the next life, remember to come home with me.
926|Everything you are, I taught you. In the end, you belong to someone else.
927|Bad moods always surge up suddenly. What I fear is not the mood, but that my head is full of you.
928|What can I compare you to? You are a pool of shimmering light I cannot scoop up.
929|This round I gave it my all. I do not want to play the next one. You know I am not talking about a game.
930|If I cannot write gentle, beautiful sentences, will you just look at my gentle heart.
931|At the best age I met the best of you. Through cold and heat, autumn harvest and winter store, I hope we have a long way to go.
932|Do not try to pry into my life. What you can see is only what I want you to see.
933|I want to use the sunset and evening wind in your eyes to write down words of love never spoken.
934|By the laws of nature, you should have met me by now.
935|I can go anywhere, but I can never reach your heart, just as you are always in mine and never see my sorrow.
936|I cannot spend my whole life just for a maybe from you.
937|The person I once held up with my own hands, I hope you never fall.
938|Since you have changed your heart, I will not hold you back.
939|What a pity we did not last until winter. It would have been nice to watch the snow with you.
940|You were the long future in my plain life, and in the end you became a sudden, vast dream.
941|The end.
942|What I mean is, thank you for appearing.
943|What was the meaning of your appearing? Even on the day you disappeared I still had not figured it out.
944|Time will not make me forget you, only make me used to your absence.
945|You are the dream I keep losing and worrying over, and I am someone dispensable to you.
946|I said it: whatever you want, I will give you, including freedom.
947|You always have too many sweet words for everyone. I always have too few, and only for you.
948|I can only walk with you this far. Take care on the road ahead.
949|May your future be bright. If nothing unexpected happens, we will never be in touch again in this life.
